description: The plot illustrates how the number of “Shared Experts for Two Samples” varies across different training data sizes for six task categories (Intent, Summary, Law, Translation, Code, Math). The x-axis is labeled with powers of two from \(2^9\) through \(2^{20}\), shown as evenly spaced tick labels (logarithmic-by-construction labeling), with one tick per exponent step. The y-axis is labeled “Shared Experts for Two Samples,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 2.0 up to 6.0 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.5 increments. Six solid lines without markers are shown: the Intent line (orange) starts near 3.8 at \(2^9\), rises with a dip around \(2^{11}\) (about 3.9), then increases to about 5.5 at \(2^{13}\) and reaches about 6.0 by \(2^{19}\)–\(2^{20}\); the Summary line (blue) starts near 2.0 at \(2^9\), climbs to about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), dips slightly around \(2^{12}\) (~4.5), then increases steadily to about 5.7 at \(2^{15}\) and approaches about 6.0 by \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\); the Law line (gold) begins around 3.6 at \(2^9\), rises to about 5.1 at \(2^{11}\), dips near \(2^{12}\) (~4.6), then increases to about 5.6–5.8 around \(2^{13}\)–\(2^{14}\) and stays near 5.9–6.0 from about \(2^{17}\) to \(2^{20}\); the Translation line (purple) starts around 5.1 at \(2^9\), peaks near 5.3 at \(2^{10}\), drops to about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), then rises to about 5.6 at \(2^{12}\) and remains high, reaching about 5.9–6.0 by \(2^{17}\)–\(2^{20}\); the Code line (gray) starts near 1.9–2.0 at \(2^9\)–\(2^{10}\), increases to about 2.9 at \(2^{11}\) and ~3.7 at \(2^{13}\), dips around \(2^{14}\) (~3.1), then climbs to about 4.8 at \(2^{16}\) and ends around 5.7–5.8 at \(2^{20}\); the Math line (green) begins near 3.8 at \(2^9\), rises steadily to about 5.3 at \(2^{13}\), continues upward to about 5.7 at \(2^{16}\), reaches about 5.9 near \(2^{18}\), dips slightly around \(2^{19}\) (~5.85), and returns to about 5.95 at \(2^{20}\).
